collection.title: Daihatsu Charade 2003 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Daihatsu Charade 2003 to 2007 requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 11" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Charade which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
